name: Gad
whenBasis: In the reigns of Saul and David, dated by counting back from Solomon; 1 Samuel 13:1, which gives Saul's age and years, is damaged in the Hebrew.
summary: A prophet with David from his outlaw days, who told him to leave the stronghold and go into the land of Judah. After David's census he brought him the LORD's choice of three punishments, and then the command to build an altar on the threshing floor of Araunah, where the temple would stand. Chronicles cites the records of Gad the seer.
body: David, given the choice of famine, flight before his enemies, or plague, answers, “Let us fall into the hand of the LORD, for His mercies are great; but do not let me fall into the hands of men.” Gad also helped set the Levites' music in the temple service, with Nathan.

moments.text: “Let us fall into the hand of the LORD”
